headers.height-encoding: uint16be; metres above the areoid = value - 32768

note: Colour is the 12.7 GB Viking MDIM21 global mosaic, which is not downloadable in one piece — it is assembled from Mars Trek's WMTS level 3, which is 16x8 tiles of 256 px and so exactly 4096x2048. Elevation is MEGDR at 16 pixels/degree (megt90n000eb.img), raw big-endian signed int16 metres, rotated half a width to match the colour map's longitude convention. Verified against named features: Olympus Mons +20504 m, Hellas Basin -6042 m.
